verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch storing collections as plain-text files in a repo or versioning them with git. The community evidence points the other way: a GitHub feature request asks for git-repo sync and .http files, which implies the capability was absent. A hands-on review also notes you can't point workspace data at a directory the way Bruno allows. The import and CLI features don't establish file-based, git-versioned collection storage.
